# 摩尔多瓦创业者，从零做到百万ARR的产品组合

**14年 bootstrapping，他说：不要等待一夜成功**

Andrei Valeanu来自摩尔多瓦共和国，现在Barcelona。

Journey began in 2010，started Designmodo as blog。2011年，side income matched salary，went full time。Independence是strong motivation。Wanted control of time，wanted ideas exist in real life，wanted tools make better——if something slowed down，tried build faster way、share with others。

现在bootstrapping internet products，no investors、no venture capital。Day to day，run business operations，lead product R&D，prototype和ship features，jump into support when needed，review SEO和content。Wear founder hat和builder hat。

产品组合：
- **Designmodo**：email builder with Postcards，plus website building with Slides和Startup
- **Siter.io**：freehand、no-code website builder
- **Static.app**：one-click static site hosting
- **Pulsetic.com**：uptime monitoring with website status badges、multi-channel alerts、public incidents、scheduled maintenance pages
- **Unspam.email**：email spam和deliverability testing
- **Absurd.design**：hand-drawn illustration project，part of team

Focus simple：Help people create和run things online with less friction。

## 二、

Process、resources、decisions比budgets更重要。Since didn't have big budget， here's what went into building products：

**Problem selection**：Test demand by publishing useful content和freebies，then watch where people struggle。

**Scope**：Ship smallest useful slice，focused和design-oriented product solve one clear job。

**Resources**：Solo或very small team，time-boxed sprints，affordable hosting，simple payments。

**Tech**：WordPress for site和early content，lightweight stack for first product，version control from day one。

**Design**：Clear UI，consistent spacing和typography，reduce choices increase success。

**Pricing**：Start free validate，add low-entry paid tier once value obvious。

**Distribution**：Twitter和Google Search brought first users。Email marketing成为key growth channel后，launched Postcards speed up email production、keep quality consistent。

**Feedback loop**：ship、observe、learn from support tickets、improve、repeat。Let behavior guide decisions。

## 三、

技术栈：
- Frontend：TypeScript、React、Next.js
- Backend：Laravel、Node.js、Go for services、Python for utilities
- Data：PostgreSQL、Redis
- Infrastructure：Docker、Kubernetes where fits、AWS、Cloudflare、global CDN、object storage
- Blogs和early projects：WordPress
- Email delivery和marketing：Postmark和Brevo
- Monitoring：Pulsetic for external checks、Grafana for dashboards

## 四、

2015-2017年，try expand into WordPress ecosystem with theme和plugin。Thesis good，但executed outside core strengths。Over-hired for speed，build cycles long，quality lagged，support volume spiked，refunds increased，revenue did not cover new burn。Cash got tight，accumulated debt。

Correction hard；reduced到core team of three，paused new feature development on those WordPress products，focused on supporting existing customers while rethought strategy。

How fixed it：
- Returned to strengths，design-oriented web和email tools
- Switched to subscriptions stabilize cash flow
- Rebuilt with lean structure和profit sharing for makers
- Set strict spending rules、monthly burn reviews、kill criteria for projects
- Shortened cycles、shipped thinner slices、used customer data drive scope

Reset culminated in 2018 relaunch of core apps和steady return to profitable、recurring revenue。

## 五、

Other challenges：

**Channel shocks**：Search updates forced traffic diversification和deeper product focus

**Multi-product prioritization**：Several products mean trade-offs；now work in clear quarterly goals with simple KPIs、say "no more" often

**Cash discipline while bootstrapping**：No investors means cash flow king，keep fixed costs lean、reinvest carefully

**Founder stamina**：Long cycles can burn out，weekly planning和small shippable steps protect momentum

If started over，would control spending even tighter，validate faster，hire slower，measure retention before adding features。Stay fully independent from investor money，plan with cash buffer，let data——not excitement——drive scope和timelines。

## 六、

Growth via education，plus product-led growth。

- Free models so people try without payment，then upgrade if product fits needs
- Word of mouth from useful features和fast support
- SEO from practical guides、examples、comparisons solve real problems
- Email marketing for onboarding、tips、launches compound over time
- Communities such as Indie Hackers和Product Hunt for early feedback和reach

初始用户来自Twitter和Google Search。

## 七、

Revenue growth levers：

- Listen to customers、release features solve specific jobs
- Shorten time to first value with clearer onboarding和quality templates
- Keep pricing simple with fair limits和annual plans
- Improve reliability、performance、support so customers stay longer

## 八、

What matters most：principles和practice。

**Principles**：
- Lead with value；Teach first，sell second
- Reinvest most profits into product和people
- Keep teams small、remote、accountable
- Default to no code for users，reduce time to value

**Practice**：
- Treat support as product research；every ticket is clue
- Track trends、watch competitors closely，then build simpler、better version for users
- Run public betas de-risk choices
- Maintain steady shipping cadence so momentum never dies

## 九、

建议：

**Do not wait for overnight success。**

Start with painful problem、deliver first win in minutes。

Build distribution while build product，write和share what learn。

Choose simple stack can operate alone。

Track activation和retention early。

Be ready pivot。Pivot是informed correction，not defeat。When data shows weak pull，narrow audience、change promise、reshape product。

Overall，protect cash，ship next experiment，keep moving。

## 写在最后

Andrei的故事是long-term bootstrapping——

14年，从blog到product portfolio，百万ARR。

Key insights——

- WordPress expansion nearly broke them（stick to strengths）
- Subscriptions stabilize cash flow
- Small teams，remote，accountable
- Education + PLG = growth
- Don't wait for overnight success

最重要的是，**he survived the WordPress mistake。**

And came back stronger。
